briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments scramble for regulatory control. US export controls on advanced chips continue to reshape global AI alliances. Competition for compute and talent remains fierce.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with multimodal reasoning gains. Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind and xAI push new scaling laws while Meta open-sources Llama 4. DeepSeek releases R2 challenging Western dominance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia Blackwell ramp faces delays; TSMC reports record AI wafer demand. Microsoft and Google announce new $50B+ data center clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced semiconductors slow China's AGI timeline more than they accelerate domestic innovation?
